subject: english
question:
Select the correctly spelt word to fill in the blank.

All the chefs in the world are famous because of their _____________ skills.
solution:
**The correct answer is option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling is 'culinary'.
 
• "Culinary" is an adjective that refers to anything related to cooking or the kitchen.

**Complete Sentence:** All the chefs in the world are famous because of their **culinary** skills.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Meaning of Culinary:** Relating to the practice of cooking or the kitchen. **(पाक-कला से संबंधित)**

 
• **Synonyms:** Gastronomic, Cooking-related
 
• **Usage:** She enrolled in a prestigious culinary school to enhance her cooking skills.
